provenance.quote: Within the first 24 hours of life he developed jitteriness, a high-pitched cry, poor feeding and mild respiratory distress requiring supplemental oxygen for 36 hours.
The neonatology team diagnosed neonatal adaptation syndrome attributed to in-utero exposure to sertraline.
